description: Removes the own price of nights in a range, so they go back to the season or base price. For one unit or (without unit_id) every unit. For one night, send only from. Acts on one venue, given its address and access key.

address.description: The venue’s address name, the "name" in name.bookare.app.

to.description: YYYY-MM-DD, inclusive. Default: same as from.

name: reset_nightly_price
title: Back to the usual price
